## System context

A poller finds the issues that carry the `longhaul` label and starts one workflow for each. The worker runs the activities, and activities do all the I/O. The console reads from the API, and the API reads Postgres and signals Temporal.

## Task lifecycle

One task, from a labeled issue to a pull request or a stuck report. The workflow only schedules activities, so every model turn and every tool call can retry on its own.
